rv.q: Watching it feels like stepping into an enchanted storybook.
Chicago families will surely enjoy and never forget this unique holiday entertainment that will resonate forever in their hearts.
If you are looking for a play to see this holiday season, I recommend the Snow Queen.
For families seeking a shard of self-reflection to offset seasonal indulgence, The Snow Queen may just be the ticket.
This is an enchanting story of faith, coming of age, sacrifice, friendship and most of all love.

cn.t: Critics praise this modern adaptation of Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale for its timely environmental themes and family-friendly magic, calling it an enchanting addition to Chicago's holiday theater offerings.
